data_sources.service: HTTP byte-range read of CRISM MTRDR SU/IF cubes
processing: map projection from SU header (Equirectangular, R=3394839.8 m, std parallel 15.0°); target pixel row 236, col 164
window 61x61 px (18 m/px); pixels > 5.0 km masked; ignore value 65535 and non-finite masked
I/F bands nearest 800, 1000, 1300, 1700, 2000, 2300 nm read (actual 801, 997, 1303, 1697, 2001, 2298 nm) for legacy band depths
limitations: MTRDR summary parameters are screening products; positive values can arise from noise, residual atmospheric CO2 or detector artefacts (Viviano-Beck et al. 2014).
CRISM targeted footprints are ~10 km wide; the analysis window covers only the part of the region imaged by the selected observation.
MTRDR I/F includes CRISM team photometric and volcano-scan atmospheric corrections; legacy band depths therefore differ in calibration from the terrestrial EMIT surface reflectance.

processing: GDS topography CSV (valid shots only, quality flag 0)
points clipped to the circular region; azimuthal-equidistant local projection
least-squares plane for regional slope; gridded central differences for local slope

mineralogy.spectral_character: Positive summary parameters: OLINDEX3 (olivine (broad 1 µm band)); BDI1000IR (Fe2+ 1 µm absorption (mafic minerals)); D2300 (Fe/Mg-OH (Fe/Mg phyllosilicates)); BD2210_2 (Al-OH (Al phyllosilicates, hydrated silica)); BD530_2 (crystalline ferric oxides); BD1435 (CO2 ice). Screening only; mineral identification requires ratioed spectra.
limitations: MTRDR summary parameters are screening products; positive values can arise from noise, residual atmospheric CO2 or detector artefacts (Viviano-Beck et al. 2014).
CRISM targeted footprints are ~10 km wide; the analysis window covers only the part of the region imaged by the selected observation.
MTRDR I/F includes CRISM team photometric and volcano-scan atmospheric corrections; legacy band depths therefore differ in calibration from the terrestrial EMIT surface reflectance.

earth_analogs.method: Euclidean distance over directly comparable band depths (legacy definition)
earth_analogs.reference_library: GEØ.IA terrestrial EMIT band-depth reference library v1.0.0 (90 sites)
approximate_proxies: BDI1000IR / LCPINDEX2 / HCPINDEX2 (Fe2+ absorptions; CRISM-specific definitions)
not_comparable: BD1900_2, D2300, BD2210_2, carbonate and sulfate parameters (no equivalent attribute in the terrestrial reference library)
CO2/H2O ice parameters (no terrestrial counterpart in the library)
ASTER TIR indices, NDVI (not measured on Mars here)
earth_analogs.disclaimer: Similarity of a few band-depth attributes. It is not a probability of mineral occurrence and does not indicate a deposit. Low discrimination: the top 5 sites lie within 0.029 band-depth units of each other. Only two attributes are compared; many geologically unrelated sites can match equally well (the library is dominated by hydrothermal ore systems).
